sql: WITH raw AS(SELECT seller_id,COUNT(*) items,SUM(price) sales,AVG(price) avg_price FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id),j AS(SELECT i.seller_id,COUNT(*) item_review_rows,SUM(i.price) joined_sales,AVG(i.price) joined_price,AVG(r.review_score*1.0) item_weighted_review FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id=i.order_id GROUP BY i.seller_id) SELECT * FROM raw JOIN j USING(seller_id) WHERE seller_id='2a7dc43cecabf23403078e2188437d1d'
